name: Setup Wizard governor: headspeed screen only for Electric and Nitro, throttle type for every mode
step: Check which governor modes lead to the headspeed screen and show the throttle type
rationale:
The governor step led on to the headspeed screen for every mode above Off. On Limit the firmware never reaches the
headspeed control, and on Direct the value only becomes a ratio, so the pilot entered a headspeed that set nothing. The
throttle type has to stay on screen for Direct: Direct runs govDataUpdate, where the type (Function among them) is
applied to the throttle, and a stored type there must remain visible and changeable.

The harness opens the real setup_wizard_governor.lua for each mode and pins: Off shows neither; Limit and Direct show the
throttle type and no way on to the headspeed screen; Electric and Nitro show both.

--self-test runs three broken copies (the headspeed screen for every mode; the throttle row hidden below Electric; the
forward action returning to the mode screen) and requires all three to go red.
